data.name: StateReady
data.value: On: every backup is also encrypted and sent to the vendor's cloud.

data.name: StateNotLicensed
data.value: Off: the license does not include cloud backup.

data.name: StateNoCode
data.value: Off: make the recovery code first.

data.name: StateNoAccess
data.value: Off: enter the backup access key the vendor gave you.

data.name: StateNoEscrow
data.value: Off: this installation has no vendor key for cloud backups. Contact the vendor.

data.name: Waiting
data.value: {0} encrypted copies waiting to be sent

data.name: WaitingNone
data.value: Nothing is waiting to be sent.

data.name: WaitingOne
data.value: 1 encrypted copy waiting to be sent

data.name: CodeExplanation
data.value: Write this recovery code down and keep it somewhere safe, away from this computer. It is shown only now. It opens the cloud backups on any computer; without it, only the vendor can help.

data.name: CodeConfirmed
data.value: The recovery code is in use. Keep the written copy safe.

data.name: AccessKeyHint
data.value: Paste the key exactly as the vendor gave it. It is kept protected on this computer and never shown again.

data.name: AccessSaved
data.value: The backup access key is saved.

data.name: AccessRemoved
data.value: The backup access key was removed. Nothing more is sent to the cloud.

data.name: CodeNeeded
data.value: Type the recovery code this backup was made with:

data.name: AskVendor
data.value: Ask the vendor to recover this backup

data.name: RequestExplanation
data.value: Send this whole text to your vendor (by e-mail or chat). It contains no business data. The vendor checks who you are and then sends back a restore key that works on this computer only.

data.name: RequestSaved
data.value: The recovery request was saved as {0}.

data.name: RequestMade
data.value: The recovery request is ready. Send it to your vendor, and keep using this computer and this Windows user until the restore key arrives.

data.name: RestoreKeyHeading
data.value: Restore with a key from the vendor

data.name: RestoreKeyHint
data.value: Paste the whole restore key the vendor sent, including the BEGIN and END lines.

data.name: NewCodeNeeded
data.value: This computer's data was restored with a key from the vendor. Make a new recovery code now and write it down: cloud backups stay off until you do.
